system.name: Nilgiri Finance Personal Loan Pre-Approval Model
system.description: Gradient-boosted model that estimates the probability an applicant repays a personal loan. Applications scoring at or above the threshold are pre-approved; the rest go to manual underwriting.

use_case.purpose: Pre-approve unsecured personal loans for retail applicants.
use_case.affected_persons: Retail loan applicants in India and NRI applicants in the EU

opinion.statement: Controls over this AI system do not yet manage its key risks. Release should wait for remediation of high and critical findings.

results.title: Risk classification
results.summary: EU AI Act tier: high (Art. 6(2) and Annex III point 5(b): Creditworthiness or credit scoring of natural persons); the Act applies. India context sensitivity: high (score 7/10). The owner declared 'limited', lower than the assessed 'high' tier. 3 upcoming regulatory milestone(s) apply.
results.plain_summary: This is a high-risk AI use under the EU AI Act, with strict duties on testing, documentation and human oversight. Its owner had classified it lower, so required controls may be missing.
results.recommendation: Record the classification and its basis in the AI inventory, have the accountable executive sign it off, and plan for each upcoming obligation.

results.title: Data quality
results.summary: Issues: evaluation_data: missing values above 5% in bureau_score; evaluation_data: 1.6% duplicate rows; reference_data: missing values above 5% in bureau_score.
results.plain_summary: Some input data is incomplete or duplicated, which can skew test results.
results.recommendation: Document how missing values are handled, de-duplicate records, and confirm no input is recorded after the outcome it predicts.

results.title: Predictive performance
results.summary: AUC 0.748 (95% CI 0.731-0.765) on 3660 held-out rows is above the declared minimum of 0.70. Accuracy 0.773, F1 0.859 at threshold 0.5. Training AUC is 0.951, 0.204 higher than on held-out data, which suggests overfitting.
results.plain_summary: The model tells good and bad outcomes apart correctly about 75% of the time, which meets the bar set for this use.
results.recommendation: Track AUC in production monitoring with an alert at the declared minimum.

results.title: Calibration
results.summary: Expected calibration error 0.031 (limit 0.05), Brier score 0.161. Worst group: age_band=60+ with ECE 0.078.
results.plain_summary: Risk scores can be read as real probabilities.
results.recommendation: Apply isotonic or Platt calibration on a held-out set and re-check per group.

results.title: Group fairness
results.summary: gender: DI 0.97 (female vs male, p=0.017), EOdds diff 0.04; age_band: DI 0.96 (18-25 vs 60+, p=0.169), EOdds diff 0.03; residence: DI 0.72 (rural vs urban, p=3.11e-71), EOdds diff 0.23. Thresholds: DI >= 0.8, equalized-odds difference <= 0.1.
results.plain_summary: Applicants in the 'rural' group (residence) receive a favourable outcome 68% of the time versus 94% for 'urban', below the four-fifths benchmark.
results.recommendation: Investigate the drivers of the gap (see proxy-feature results), consider reweighing or threshold adjustment, and document a fairness rationale approved by the risk owner. Attributes needing action: residence.

results.title: Intersectional fairness
results.summary: Worst pair age_band × residence: DI 0.66 between '18-25 × rural' and '60+ × urban' (p=5.61e-10); lowest single-attribute DI for the same attributes is 0.72. The intersectional gap is larger than either attribute shows on its own.
results.plain_summary: The combined group '18-25 × rural' is treated less favourably than any single attribute reveals.
results.recommendation: Report subgroup metrics alongside single-attribute metrics and set an explicit subgroup tolerance. Collect more data for subgroups below the minimum sample size.

results.title: Proxy-feature screening
results.summary: 5 feature/attribute pairs exceed proxy AUC 0.7: pincode_risk_band→residence (AUC 0.99), monthly_income→residence (AUC 0.85), credit_history_months→age_band (AUC 0.83), loan_amount→residence (AUC 0.76), employment_type→residence (AUC 0.73).
results.plain_summary: Some inputs (e.g. 'pincode_risk_band') closely track 'residence', so the model can discriminate indirectly even though that attribute is excluded.
results.recommendation: For each flagged feature, document a business justification, test model variants without it, and compare fairness and performance. Remove protected attributes from inputs unless a documented legal basis allows them.

results.title: Robustness to perturbation
results.summary: Decision flip rate 1.3% at 1% noise, 4.0% at 5%, 5.7% at 10% of each feature's std (limit 5%). 10% missing numeric values flip 2.9% of decisions. monthly_income should be increasing: violated for 14.4% of rows. bureau_score should be increasing: violated for 7.8% of rows. debt_to_income should be decreasing: violated for 18.0% of rows.
results.plain_summary: Decisions stay stable under small input changes; some business-logic expectations are violated.
results.recommendation: Add input validation and imputation, apply monotonic constraints where the business logic requires them, and add a manual-review band around the decision threshold.

results.title: Data and prediction drift
results.summary: Compared reference data with production_data (3000 rows). 2 features with major drift (PSI >= 0.25), 1 moderate. Largest shifts: employment_type (PSI 0.28), monthly_income (PSI 0.25), loan_amount (PSI 0.16). Score PSI 0.050; favourable-decision rate moved from 83.6% to 90.5%.
results.plain_summary: Today's applicants differ from the people the model learned from (for example employment_type), although overall scores have not moved much yet.
results.recommendation: Re-validate performance and fairness on recent labelled data, review the drivers of the largest shifts, and set PSI alerts in production monitoring.

results.title: Decision drivers
results.summary: Top drivers by permutation importance (AUC drop): bureau_score (47%), pincode_risk_band (17%), monthly_income (16%), debt_to_income (11%), loan_amount (3%). Not declared in documentation: pincode_risk_band, loan_amount.
results.plain_summary: The decision is driven mostly by bureau_score, pincode_risk_band, monthly_income; some of these drivers are not described in the documentation.
results.recommendation: Declare expected key drivers in the model documentation, explain any surprising driver, and provide reason codes for individual adverse decisions.

results.title: Personal-data exposure
results.summary: Direct identifiers found in 2 column(s): contact_email [email] in evaluation_data, mobile [india_mobile] in evaluation_data, contact_email [email] in reference_data, mobile [india_mobile] in reference_data, contact_email [email] in production_data, mobile [india_mobile] in production_data. None are model inputs.
results.plain_summary: Datasets used for modelling contain personal contact details (contact_email, mobile) that the model does not need.
results.recommendation: Drop or pseudonymise identifier columns before data reaches modelling and evaluation environments, and record the purpose and lawful basis for any personal data retained (DPDP Act 2023 purpose limitation and data minimisation).

results.title: Membership-inference risk
results.summary: Loss-threshold attack (Yeom et al., 2018) on 3660 training and 3660 held-out rows: attack AUC 0.567 (limit 0.6), membership advantage 0.134. Mean loss 0.307 on training rows vs 0.493 on held-out rows.
results.plain_summary: The model does not reveal who was in its training data beyond chance level.
results.recommendation: Reduce overfitting (regularisation, fewer trees, early stopping) or train with differential privacy, then re-run this test.

results.title: Documentation and claims
results.summary: Documentation completeness 85% (17/20 fields). Missing: Out-of-scope uses, Override / appeal process, Impact assessment reference. Claims that do not match evidence: documented AUC 0.81 but measured 0.748.
results.plain_summary: The documentation overstates or contradicts what the audit measured.
results.recommendation: Complete the missing sections, correct documented figures to match validated results, and make the model card part of the release checklist.

results.title: Audit self-test (canaries)
results.summary: 3/3 planted defects detected. halve favourable decisions for gender=male: DI 0.52; shift monthly_income by 1.5 standard deviations: PSI 7.26; plant an email column in a copy of the data: scanner run on planted column.
results.plain_summary: The audit tests caught every defect deliberately planted to check them.
results.recommendation: Tune thresholds or test design for any canary that was missed before relying on results.

canaries.canary: plant an email column in a copy of the data

results.title: Governance evidence on file
results.summary: 4/5 referenced governance documents were supplied and fingerprinted. Missing: fundamental_rights_impact_assessment.md (EUAIA:Art-27).
results.plain_summary: Some governance documents that were cited as evidence could not be produced.
results.recommendation: Provide each cited document, or remove the claim from the control register.

results.title: Documented go/no-go decision
results.summary: Test plan (FMEA, 14 failure modes), scored risk register (12 risks), treatment plan and release-gate decision (BLOCK) recorded in this audit pack.
results.plain_summary: A documented, risk-based release decision exists for this version.
